case_number: 2025 INSC 59; CONTEMPT PETITION (C) NO. 372, 373, 376 OF 2019; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 2703 OF 2017

parties.petitioner: Gopal Sharan Singh, Mahendra Kumar Singh, Shyam Sharan Shah

summary: Contempt petitions for non-payment of arrears following absorption orders; J. Sinha Commission recommendations confirmed; State submitted arrears paid for working days; attendance verification disputes; fact-finding enquiry required; pension claims linked to absorption date; Registrar/Vice Chancellor directed to adjudicate claims within three months; excess payment recoverable; High Court appeal preserved.
legal_provisions_cited: State of Bihar & others vs Bihar Rajya M.S.E.S.K.K.M & others (2005) 9 SCC 129
final_judgment: Contempt petitions disposed of with directions for Registrar/Vice Chancellor to adjudicate claims on working days, salary arrears, and pension within three months; excess payment recovery permitted; High Court appeal option preserved.
